SUNDAY CLOSED

    Why are we closed on Sunday? Because everybody needs a day off, that's why. I (Hank) started this business with my wife Linda in 1987 and we've always been closed on Sundays. The crew goes to church, has dinner with their families, watches the Browns lose. If you really need something on a Sunday, plan ahead and rent it Saturday morning — the weekly rate covers you through Monday return anyway. Please don't call the shop on Sundays. Nobody is there.

Directions & Location
4427 Industrial Way
Sandusky, OH 44870

Map of our location at 4427 Industrial Way

From the Ohio Turnpike (I-80/90):
    Take Exit 118 (US-250). Head north on US-250 about 4 miles. Turn LEFT on Perkins Avenue. Go about 1.5 miles, then turn RIGHT on Industrial Way. We're the third building on the left, with the big orange sign.

From Downtown Sandusky:
    Take Columbus Avenue south to Perkins Avenue. Turn RIGHT (west) on Perkins. Go about 2 miles. Turn LEFT on Industrial Way. Third building on the left.

From Cedar Point / Route 6:
    Head west on Route 6 (Cleveland Road). Turn LEFT on Campbell Street. Go south about 1 mile to Perkins Avenue. Turn RIGHT, then LEFT on Industrial Way.

From the West (Toledo/Fremont):
    Take Route 2 east to Route 4. Go south on Route 4 to Perkins Avenue. Turn LEFT (east) on Perkins. About 3 miles, then RIGHT on Industrial Way.

Landmarks: We're two blocks south of the old Ford plant, across the street from Bob's Diner. If you hit the railroad tracks you've gone too far — turn around.

Common Questions
Q: Can I rent online?
A: No. We do not have an online rental system and we don't plan to. Please call us at (419) 555-2847 or stop in.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Not usually. For party tents, large equipment, or weekend rentals during the busy season, we recommend reserving by phone a few days ahead.

Q: What do I need to bring?
A: A valid driver's license and a credit card for the deposit. Cash, check, or credit card accepted for the rental itself.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: Yes, within Erie County and parts of Huron and Ottawa counties. Delivery fees depend on distance and equipment. Call for a quote.

Q: What if the equipment breaks during my rental?
A: Call us right away. If it's a defect or wear-out we'll swap it out at no charge. If you broke it, we'll let you know what the repair cost is.

Q: Do you sell parts or accessories?
A: A few common consumables — sandpaper, bar oil, blades. We're a rental shop, not a hardware store.
